Pictures are blurred and the effort of the men certainly in my age group (50+) is dyer. They want a woman who is pristine, well turned out and high effort yet can’t even be bothered to make an effort themselves. Don’t even get me started on the idiots who think it’s ok to try and match with someone 300miles away !! Just why ???? I will never sign up to match again, I’d rather be single if that’s all there is on offer !!

reviews.title: Repeated account blocks for political expression
reviews.text:
I had a very negative experience with Match.com. My account was repeatedly blocked and then reinstated, even though I did not post anything illegal or inappropriate. When I expressed a political view supporting “Free Palestine” and stating I do not want to date people who support genocide in Gaza, displacement in Lebanon, or extreme-right parties, my account was flagged and my access was restricted.
I found the process confusing, inconsistent, and ultimately biased. If the platform restricts users based on viewpoint rather than actual policy violations, that’s a serious problem. After this experience, I refused to appeal again & asked for my account and personal data to be deleted. I don’t recommend Match.com & would not even give it one star if I could.

reviews.title: Not the best design
reviews.text:
What I like:
1. Browsing and sorting profiles With the free plan, you can browse profiles based on your selected area and age range (these are the only filters you can try with free plan!), and you can then sort the profiles. It’s a small feature, but it does make browsing a little easier.

What I don’t like:
1. Too many essential features are locked behind payment Almost all useful features require a paid subscription. You cannot communicate with people you have matched with, not even one person, unless you pay for a plan. The additional filters are also locked, so you cannot filter for basic preferences such as whether someone smokes or drinks. As a result, the free version feels like you can do little more than browse profiles.
2. Profile-photo verification is frustrating The verification interface is slow, not user-friendly, and repeatedly rejects photos. In my experience, the process was unnecessarily difficult, despite having completed photo verification successfully on other platforms before.
3. The “Forgot my password” function doesn’t work I tried the password-reset option multiple times and never received a reset email. Even more frustrating, when I contacted support, I received an email telling me to use the exact same “Forgot my password” button, which was precisely the problem I was contacting them about in the first place!

The filter in the search function allows me to set criteria for distance but browsing outside off that or seeing those who viewed you does not have this metric.  There is no longer a timestamp for when a person viewed you, just a list of users making it hard to identify new views from older views.  The search criteria has had all criteria linked to interests removed making it a very superficial search.  For some reason sensitivity of swipe feature has increased so when scrolling a profile even a slight deviation from centre shows as a decision left or right.  My subscription is due to lapse and not be renewed.

reviews.text:
Update: finally resolved after a competent professional support person picked up my messages - however I’ve terminated my subscription as the outages and app issues went on too long and it took multiple messages from me to get actual responses to my issues and queries instead of basic copy and paste responses without reading the thread for my support request where I’d already explained issues, iOS version, app version etc and got asked over and over for the same info. 

I decided after a year away to give Match another ago and it’s been disastrous. The recent major update took the service down for around 24hrs but then stumbled along once semi-resurrected. Since then I have raised multiple issues through customer support and been fobbed off with generic copy & paste responses. I lost contact with a match because notifications and messages etc were massively out of sync and they still are each day with likes being notified and nothing visible in the app despite checking immediately and then later they actually appear. I’ve asked for my monthly subscription to be cancelled but been told I have to pay for the remaining months and despite cancelling Match seem to think they still ah e the ring to take money when the service hasn’t work so much of the time.  I’ve just tried accessing the in app help and received a bad gateway error so even that didn’t work right now. 
I want a refund and I certainly don’t want any more payments taking from my bank account!

reviews.title: Blocked For No Reason Post Update!
reviews.text:
Currently half way through a 6 month Subscription & all was ok(ish) until this update!
GUI was a complete joke post upgrade. 

The main issue though… While I was on the (updated) app just (trying) to see who had viewed my profile, the app suddenly booted me out & back to the Sign Up/Logon page. 
Now when I try to Logon I get a message saying my Account has been blocked by Match!

When you click on the link to contact Customer Care you just get an error screen saying site cannot be reached!

Emailed Customer Care direct & filled out an online form (good old Google) & did actually get generic replies saying they can’t find my details & to either contact them from the site while logged in!!… or… to email them from the email address used to register which it was (& is the only personal email address I have) 🤦‍♂️

Having been a loyal customer of Match (on & off) over the last couple of years (not very good at this online dating thing!), I can only see this as a sign to ‘Get the message’ & move on!… 🤣

But seriously, going round in circles with Customer Care yet they still managed to take payment the other day?!… so will be cancelling all future payments from today as I’m not paying for something I have NO access to!…

reviews.title: Awful update
reviews.text:
Well done! Don’t know how you managed it but you did. You made a pretty bad app even worse with your latest update. App is unusable and I struggle to log in on a computer. When I do I find that the subscription I paid for is now no longer accessible so all I have is the basic free version which is pointless. I’m guessing you’ll be correcting the problem your update caused by issuing me a refund?

Update:
Generic response regarding this review that appears on other negative reviews. I had already contacted match customer services. It appears they tried to put it down to my platforms, which it clearly isn’t having seen the recent reviews and the generic response being issued. Have asked for a refund but it appears that that is being ignored. Match have massively failed with this update, as a user you are bound by their terms and conditions but they can’t even provide a usable app and have no qualms about failing to reimburse you for THEIR problems.

reviews.title: Give me my money back!
reviews.text:
A few days ago I paid for a one week subscription, only a few days in and its already unusable. This is now the second day that there has been no access. Over 12 hours yesterday the site was offline ‘under maintenance’ This morning the desktop site was accessible again, and there was update to the app. But it looked and performed like what i can only describe as what match would have looked like in 1996 on dial up! Poor UI, and constant spinning blue discs. It was far from unusable for a few hours this morning, taking on average 5 seconds to just load in each profile - but once again its now completely unusable, the desktop site says my profile doesnt exist, and the app is 90% empty, no matches, no highlights, and most pages just have a ‘failed to load - try again’ error message. 

Not fit for purpose, i want a refund.
